description: Coverage: 274 public and private school records in Escambia, Santa Rosa and Okaloosa counties in Florida, and Baldwin County in Alabama. 3 school-published campus additions supplement the dated federal directory. 119 Florida grades (2025-26) and 46 Alabama grades (2024-25) are linked by state district and school identifiers. Alabama also reports 1 approved waiver; 3 directory schools have no school-level result in that release. The two states use different accountability systems; letters are not an interstate ranking. Federal directory years and state accountability years differ.

fieldNotes.reportUrl: Relative school guide path on either Costin site; multiple source identities can share one guide.
fieldNotes.grade: Official public-school accountability grade, when published. Florida and Alabama use different years and formulas; do not rank across states.
fieldNotes.christian: Reported affiliation, not an academic rating. null means unknown.
fieldNotes.lat: Recorded or sourced approximate location. null for virtual schools and unconfirmed campuses. Not an attendance boundary.
fieldNotes.sourceYear: Directory vintage, independent of the accountability grade year. dataBuiltAt is a compilation date, not a claim that every source was refreshed.
fieldNotes.gradeStatus: Source status can include a waiver or missing result. Neither is a failing grade.
